Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class WebMonitoringController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.WebMonitoringController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/monitoring") public class WebMonitoringController extends Object
REST controller for manually triggering web monitoring harvests and inspecting stored page content hashes.

Provides on-demand triggers for the scheduled competitor page and HuggingFace model discovery jobs, useful for testing and ad-hoc updates.

    • triggerEmbedding

      @PostMapping("/embeddings") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> triggerEmbedding()
      Manually triggers article embedding into the vector store.

      Delegates to EmbeddingScheduler.embedArticles() to embed all persisted articles. Useful for populating the vector store on-demand without waiting for the scheduled cron.

      Returns:
      simple text confirmation with the result

    • triggerSentimentPipeline

      @PostMapping("/sentiment-pipeline") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> triggerSentimentPipeline()
      Runs the full sentiment pipeline: creates/enriches profiles for anchor companies from their topic feeds, discovers startups, then runs LLM sentiment analysis across all profiles.

      Anchor companies (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS) get profiles built from their dedicated topic feed articles. Discovered startups get profiles enriched with title-matched and topic-matched articles. Finally, AnalyzeCompanySentimentUseCase.analyzeAll() runs LLM sentiment classification on every profile with enough articles.

      Returns:
      JSON result with profile and sentiment counts
